description: This source file defines an Android activity called BackupActivity that manages backup functionalities within the app. It includes UI setup, handling backup creation, restoration, deletion, and displaying a list of backups with relevant details.

classes.name: BackupActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that manages backup operations including creating, restoring, and deleting backups, and displaying the list of backups.

classes.name: BackupInfo
classes.description: A data class representing information about a backup, including its ID, timestamp, and size.

classes.name: BackupAdapter
classes.description: A RecyclerView adapter for displaying backup items, with callbacks for restore and delete actions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, and loads backups.

methods.name: setupRecyclerView
methods.description: Configures the RecyclerView with its layout manager and adapter.

methods.name: setupBackupButton
methods.description: Sets the click listener for the backup creation button.

methods.name: loadBackups
methods.description: Loads backup data from storage (currently a placeholder).

methods.name: updateBackupList
methods.description: Updates the displayed list of backups and toggles visibility of empty / list views.
